title: A High-Quality Dataset and Reliable Evaluation for Interleaved Image-Text Generation
reasoning: The paper introduces the InterSyn dataset and SynJudge evaluation model, which include specific components for evaluating religious and spiritual content. The topic hierarchy (detailed in Section D.2) explicitly includes categories like 'Religion & Religious Sites' and 'Spiritual Culture', featuring topics such as the Western Wall, the Tree of Life in different religions, and religious believers.
